info.name: BiteSync Master API (Autonomous E2E - Phases 1, 2, 3A & 3B Step 4)
info.description: Complete single-click, infinitely re-runnable Master E2E Postman Collection covering API Gateway, user-service (Auth, Refresh, Logout Blacklist, Multi-Role RBAC), restaurant-service (MongoDB Onboarding, Ownership Isolation, ESR Composite Cursor Pagination, Hybrid L1/L2/Pub-Sub Caching, Kafka Order Validation Saga), and order-service (Command Side, SHA-256 API Idempotency, Transactional Outbox, Choreography Saga, and CQRS Read Model Projection & Query API).
